verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government filing service, since such a service could publish tooling for programmatic filing, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a CLI: the docs cover only browser-based Gateway and OH|TAX portal workflows behind OHID sign-in, and the probes found the SoS hosts returning 403 even on robots.txt. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".
